projects.description: Kubernetes GitOps workflow on kind with ArgoCD auto-syncing from Git and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring live app metrics. Recovered a live-injected liveness-probe failure via git revert, not manual patching.
Production CI/CD pipeline for a Vite web app on GitLab CI, cutting build-to-deploy time under 90 seconds. Dockerized and deployed on AWS EC2 behind Nginx as a reverse proxy.
Password-protected file storage and sharing tool with subject-section organization, hardened with Helmet and rate-limiting, on Backblaze B2.
